content: Implement repository, validation schemas, and ranking service for user search
activeForm: Implementing repository, validation schemas, and ranking service for user search
description: Implement user-search.repository.ts with executeSearchQuery and countTotalResults methods for searching users with filters (username, full_name, location, sport, skill_level). Create Zod validation schemas (user-search.schema.ts) for query parameters including pagination defaults (limit=20, max=100) and enum validations. Implement user-ranking.service.ts with calculateRelevance and sortByRelevance for search result ranking (exact matches, partial matches, recently active users). Write 8 MVP-tier tests (4 integration tests for database queries with JOIN operations and index usage, 2 validation tests for schema validation and defaults, 2 ranking tests for relevance scoring). Excludes soft-deleted users (is_active=false). This subtask provides the data access layer, validation, and ranking logic that will be used by the search service in T5.2.
